name: Plant Nerd Hand Roll | Soap
description: Soap has a smooth minty, pinene nose and equally smooth energizing high while boasting high THC content. We’re growing Soap for the folks who want to smoke before a heated game of pickleball, going for a bike ride, or anything else you want to feel great for.
